'''2015 European Championship Day 2 Jimmy Faelens LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jimmy Faelens]] at [[2015 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jimmy Faelens]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Username:''' JIMMY FRENCH
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125919/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-european-championships.html Internet Archive]
